fixtures_and_limits: Native chapter controls start from a disposable copied-save room arrival. No research save is written into the actual battery.

Regular attack controls isolate a one-species spawn budget. Native enemy HP, AI, movement, hit detection and reactions; player HP resets only between complete programs, plus labelled ending-clear refills.

Conductor Red/Black no-refill wins use the actual19-unit native player maximum. The four-program study heals the player, reaches half HP through actual player attacks, and establishes damaging Crownfall; not a difficulty run.

Hoist Red/Black no-refill controls use copied-save kit/Vitality purchases with60-unit native maximum and an explicit initial approach placement. Every fight, return movement, sphere interaction and fresh Continue is native. This fixture is never installed in the player save.

Final Freight/Observatory mixed clears heal the player and keep enemy HP/spawns/damage/callbacks native. Roof observations show Wardens attacking above the train and Skitters reaching elevated space; not every species has an attack at every elevation.
Black tower/stair route and Red boss-return route preset already-cleared progress in disposable RAM; paired earned saves and fresh Continue independently establish persistence.
Six recorded native R responses avoid their active windows; other HP drops remain in that control. No claim of a no-damage run.

Full-route balance, player presentation/fun acceptance and actual DeSmuME pacing remain unconfirmed. Ballast can repeat navigation hops when a target stays directly above a Freight overhang; tested ground attack coverage is separate from that remaining pursuit limit.
